lead_headline: Snarf's expands to Montbello, 85°C Bakery preps Aurora debut, Syrup Cherry Creek closes after 16 years

restaurant.blurb: 2 new leads: Snarf's opens Montbello location, 85°C Bakery (Taiwanese chain) preps Kennedy debut. Closures: Syrup Cherry Creek ends 16-year run, Wellness Sushi shutters Congress Park.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications Tuesday as liquor processing returns to dead calm after last week's administrative backlog purge. No status changes, no removals — complete standstill contrasts sharply with Wednesday's 267-filing anomaly. Week finishes at 7 applications total vs. prior week's 263 (inflated by anomaly spike). System stabilizes at pre-anomaly baseline: typical weeks run 5-8 filings, suggesting normal administrative cadence resumes after processing teams cleared Wednesday's data dump.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Tuesday extends citation blackout to 14 consecutive days — BusinessDen invisible across all monitored outlets since August 4. Zero active sources, all-time total frozen at 1,167 mentions from 111 lifetime sources. Past 30 days: 98 mentions total (down from 104 yesterday as August 4 citations age out of 30-day window). Points to sustained syndication breakdown, monitoring failure, or editorial cycle shift rather than normal variance.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) as Monday acquisition trickles to single-digit gain. MTD improves to +4 (+0.2/day) while 90-day net reaches +80. Past 7 days: +23 net (37 new, 14 canceled) vs. prior week's −21 — clean reversal driven by low churn (14 vs. 40 cancellations) and steady acquisition pace. Recent pattern: sporadic new-subscriber bursts (Saturday's 13, Sunday's 7) offset by quiet weekdays like Monday's lone add. Week-over-week momentum real but lumpy — cancellation discipline holds while acquisition remains event-driven rather than steady-state. MTD crawls toward breakeven as August stabilizes after early-month churn drag.
